instructions:
1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Step your left foot back into a lunge, lowering until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nearly touches the floor.
3. Push through your right heel to stand up, driving your left knee up toward your chest.
4. Lower your left leg back to the start under control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee tracking over your ankle, not collapsing inward.
2. Drive the knee up fast but lower it with control to stay balanced.
3. Keep your torso upright and brace your core throughout.
4. Exhale as you drive the knee up, inhale as you step back.

instructions:
1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Step your right foot forward into a lunge, lowering until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nearly touches the floor.
3. Pause for one to two seconds at the bottom.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the start.
5. Step your left foot forward and repeat the lunge and pause on that side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee tracking over your ankle, not past your toes.
2. Use the pause to control balance and keep tension in the working leg.
3. Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
4. Exhale as you push back up, inhale as you step forward.

instructions:
1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Step your right foot forward into a lunge, lowering until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nearly touches the floor.
3. Pause briefly at the bottom.
4. Push through your right heel to return to the start, keeping the same leg forward.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee tracking over your ankle, not past your toes.
2. Keep your back straight and chest lifted to hold posture.
3. Control the return to the start to stay balanced.
4. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Step your right foot back, keeping the right leg straight and the heel flat on the floor.
3. Bend your left knee and keep your left foot flat on the floor.
4. Lean forward, pressing your hips down until you feel a stretch in your right calf, and hold 15 to 30 seconds.
5. Switch legs and repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the back leg straight and the heel pressed down to target the gastrocnemius.
2. Keep your front knee aligned over your ankle.
3. Use a stable, non-slip surface to avoid slipping.
4. Breathe steadily and ease deeper into the stretch on each exhale.
